notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded embedded Federate Resigned path to the Requirements Lab's explicit 4.13 requirement. A private, test-only RTI-side membership-control seam removes a joined federate through the ordinary NO_ACTION registry path only when that path's ownership/acquisition preconditions already hold, preserves the RTI connection, resets joined state, and queues the exact official callback. When the selected §11.5 route is a report file or public MOM interaction, that same irreversible transaction reserves the final serial before member removal and emits the source-supplied reason text before the callback is queued. The paired Catch2 scenarios also prove that a federate-initiated Resign Federation Execution does not emit this callback and that Connection Lost remains distinct. This is source/test traceability only: it is not a public administration API, remote transport/session-timeout behavior, full forced-resignation disposition policy, protected-review evidence, package support, or conformance evidence.
